Alicia (Design): Quick UX question for the Deploy form — do we go with inline field errors or a top-level error summary? Also debating required indicators (asterisk-only vs visible 'Required' label). And for destructive actions (Delete/Rollback) should we use typed confirms, checkbox + modal, or snackbar + undo?
Mat (PM): Leaning inline for immediate fixes, with a short summary only for batch/submit-blocking errors. Required: asterisk + helper that says 'Required' for complex forms. For deletion of model artifacts: typed confirm for deletion, rollback could be modal with a reason + toast undo.
Jia (Eng): From implementation POV inline errors are simpler for UX flow. If we add a summary it needs keyboard focus and aria-live so screen readers notice. Also we should avoid error modals — keep errors contextual.
Aria (Accessibility): Accessibility nits: asterisk alone isn't enough — screen readers don't announce visual indicators. Add visually-hidden 'Required' text (or include the word in the label). Don't rely on color alone for error state — include icon + text and ensure contrast meets AA. For submission summary use role=alert and focus trap considerations.
Alicia (Design): Draft microcopy ideas:
- Option A (inline): label + small gray 'Required' helper underneath, field outline becomes red + inline message 'Please enter a model name'.
- Option B (summary-first): top banner '3 problems — press tab to navigate' with jump-to-field links, fields have short inline hints.
For destructive modal copy: heading 'Delete model variant', body 'Type the model variant name to confirm', secondary checkbox 'Also remove rollout configs'.
Mat (PM): :thumbsup: Option A + summary for submission-level issues sounds good. For rollback I'd prefer modal + toast undo (30s) so devs can recover quickly.
Jia (Eng): Note: typed-confirm is annoying for long names and on mobile. We should allow paste and consider partial matching with a confirm dropdown to reduce friction.
Aria (Accessibility): Also: when validation runs on blur, announce the inline error via aria-live polite. When the user submits and we show a summary, move focus to the summary and expose links to each invalid field (aria-describedby pointing to message). Keyboard users should be able to tab into each jump link.
Alicia (Design): Quick poll — react with :one: for 'asterisk + sr-only Required' or :two: for 'visible "Required" label'.
Mat (PM): Reacted :one:.
Bryan (Product): Reacted :two: — I lean visible label for forms with many optional fields so users don't guess.
ops-bot: ops-bot: checklist updated — added 'validation a11y' and 'confirmation copy' items to Deploy form checklist.
Alicia (Design): Thanks — I'll iterate the frames and post updated artboards later today. If anyone has quick examples of typed-confirm alternatives, drop them here.
